modules.title: Working and Episodic Memory StarChip
modules.mission: Learn to capture recent experiences without confusing a recorded event with a durable memory or a changed biological engram.
features: Provide bounded working context with eviction rules and source attribution
Partition episodes by user, device, project and consent scope
Train retrieval with time-separated examples, paraphrases and negative distractors
Promote only validated episodic summaries to candidate Roots
inputs: WindEvent; permissioned user action; timestamped task outcome; raw reference
outputs: EpisodeRecord; short-context summary; retrieval candidates; promotion proposal
modules.algorithm: Append input to an event log; extract task/context/outcome; form semantic and temporal indexes; run held-out retrieval probes; reject leakage from future events; pass promotion proposals to the Root Registry.
modules.measure: MRR@k, recall@k, false-memory rate, evidence-link coverage, answer latency and retention by interval; report per-source and per-user slices.
validation: A held-out question resolves to the correct episode with a source pointer
Conflicting or revoked episodes do not become authoritative
No future or sealed test event can enter a training answer
risks: Summaries can hallucinate details
Over-remembering exposes private context
High retrieval scores can reflect source leakage
modules.research: Neural response signals are candidate task features, not direct readouts of personal autobiographical memories. Biological short-term plasticity must be demonstrated independently.
build: Implement permissioned episode ledger
Create temporal and semantic retrieval baselines
Add delayed recall benchmark and evidence QA

modules.title: Long-Term Storage and Consolidation StarChip
modules.mission: Preserve durable, queryable knowledge across restarts and model changes, with explicit review before a claim becomes rooted.

Create versioned semantic indexes and snapshots with recovery points
Separate factual source, interpretation, capability, and personal preference
Propose spaced rehearsal only for consented, independently testable competencies
inputs: EpisodeRecord; document objects; validated findings; Root promotion proposal
outputs: LongTermObject; retrieval index; consolidation receipt; retention report
modules.algorithm: Stage content under a scoped identity; compute hashes; commit metadata and immutable objects atomically; build indexes; test retrieval after time- and topic-disjoint delays; keep revisions as new nodes rather than overwriting provenance.
modules.measure: Bit-integrity error rate, retrieval accuracy, stale-result rate, snapshot recovery time, topic-shift performance, old-skill noninferiority.
validation: Reboot and restore preserve source-addressed objects
Conflicting sources remain distinguishable
A failed retention probe blocks a biological-memory claim
risks: A storage snapshot is not a neural engram backup
Index corruption may appear as forgetting
Repetition may teach the evaluator
modules.research: Neural consolidation and digital data durability are different forms of persistence. Delayed biological function is a separate empirical endpoint.
build: Implement content-addressed ledger
Version indexes and snapshot recovery test
Compare immediate vs delayed held-out retrieval

modules.title: Healing and Integrity Recovery Network

validation: Unknown faults route to HOLD and review

A successful fix leaves immutable action and test history
risks: Repair actions can mask deterioration
Repeated stimulation or resource increase is not a default fix
Software rollback does not undo plasticity
modules.research: This network does not autonomously repair tissue or cure disease. A laboratory defines any biological treatment and requalification.

Implement action receipt ledger
